video:video.video:title: Why “doing AI” makes your token costs explode
video:video.video:description: Every task moves from open-ended exploration to a repeatable process. AI transformation means moving each task off frontier models once it crosses that threshold, so token cost per task falls over time instead of exploding.

video:video.video:title: Talking to your data: why natural language analytics needs a semantic layer
video:video.video:description: We built a tool that lets anyone on the team ask questions of company data in plain English. It only worked once we built a semantic layer that teaches the AI what our terms mean and how our datasets connect.
